kaikki_vikisozluk.t: Borrowed from Middle Persian *tāzag. Doublet of dialectal طَازَة (ṭāza), from Ottoman Turkish.
See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
Elative of طَازَج (ṭāzaj, “fresh; healthy, sound, pure”).
g: healthier, sounder, purer; healthiest, soundest, purest
